technical.zh-CN: iLoabot-M 采用四维机器视觉和雷达导航，支持箱装、袋装货物装卸，声明可适配现有货车与月台；具体货物尺寸和节拍尚缺。
technical.en: iLoabot-M combines four-dimensional machine vision and LiDAR navigation for boxed/bagged cargo, claiming compatibility with existing trucks and loading docks. Cargo-size limits and cycle times remain absent.

original_product_line: 自主作业机器人、iLoabot-M 装卸机器人
original_application_wording: 物流分拣、装卸搬运、制造装配、实验室与医疗物流
original_tags: 具身智能装卸与重载物流机器人
